text_block_list.text:
The year-end Arima Kinen. I came to watch 
the race with Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Today's gotta be Oguri Cap's day! Being 
one of the Eternal Big Three ain't just 
for show!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Ogrin hasn't seemed quite herself 
lately. I wonder what's wrong..."

Lately, Oguri Cap has been in an 
uncharacteristic slump—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Oguriin!! Go, go, go! Get 'eeeem!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah... Gh... haaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Haa, haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ogurin didn't quite have her usual 
sharpness today...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Is she feeling sick...? I wonder if she's 
eating properly...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry, everyone...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Why, I wonder...? I don't know either. 
Even I don't...

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
If you're not feeling well, I want you to 
rest up... Seeing Ogurin run in pain... 
...is something I just don't want to 
see...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Oguri-san has been looking down the 
whole time, even in the paddock.
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's because my form has been 
slumping lately.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —However, if that's how it is...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The grandstands at Nakayama Racecourse are 
packed with the largest crowd in history!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the horses are entering the track 
for the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Backed by countless fans, taking 1st place 
in the fan vote is Oguri Cap!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaah! Ogriiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan B
text_block_list.text: Oguri! Oguri!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oguri-san!! Keep your head up!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Miss Oguri, you are someone who absorbs 
the cheers of this massive crowd and turns 
it into strength!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That is your strength!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If you keep looking down and closing 
yourself off, you'll never unleash your 
true power!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—I know it full well! The true extent of 
your strength!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If you cannot believe in yourself, then 
believe in my words!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"You are strong!! You are the 'Monster,' 
Oguri Cap!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That's right!! Ogrin is strong! I love 
watching Ogrin run!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Oguri can win this!! She's definitely 
gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you....

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...The voices cheering for me. They fill 
my empty self with a surge of warm 
power...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—I'll show them! To answer every single 
cheer!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oguri takes the lead! Oguri takes the 
lead! In first place is Oguri Cap!!
(Waaaaaahhhhh!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Oguri-san.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That was a run worthy of Oguri-san!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"That is the very strength of yours that I 
have yearned so desperately to overcome."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yaeno... thank you!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—However, next time, I want to run with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Because I know firsthand. I know how 
strong Yaeno Muteki truly is.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Understood.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I will stand by your side 
without fail!

And so, the Arima Kinen drew to a close 
with a firm promise between Yaeno Muteki 
and Oguri Cap—
